description: X5Browser updated to 1.5.0 with 5 new tools (Google search, page fetch, Markdown read, image extract, page triggers), and install.py now checks the browser (official Chrome + environment via the library doctor) before asking for the owner email.
features: Browser library updated from 1.4.0 to 1.5.0 (44 tools: 43 library + show_preview).
New: quick_search (Google results as JSON), fetch_pages (URLs as clean Markdown), read_markdown, extract_image, manage_triggers.
Install runs the X5Browser doctor before the owner email and offers to install official Chrome when missing (never blocks the install).
